editorial:
Imagine finding out your dead dad left you a creepy, old pub in Berlin, but there is a huge catch. You play as Iris, who thinks she is just getting a piece of real estate, only to find out she now owns a monster in the basement. This creature, Baghead, can turn into any dead person if you have a piece of them. The vibe is super eerie and makes you wonder if talking to the dead is ever actually a good idea. It starts off as a mystery and slowly turns into a nightmare as Iris realizes the monster has its own scary plans.

The acting is solid and the creature design is genuinely creepy without trying too hard. While the middle part of the movie slows down a bit, the tension builds up to a wild finish that keeps you guessing. If you like stories about deals with the devil or spooky family secrets, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking twist showing that the monster was manipulating everything from the start. Iris thinks she can control the entity, but Baghead actually wants to swap places with her to enter the real world. In the final scenes, the monster successfully tricks her, leaving Iris trapped in the dark basement while the creature takes over her life. It is a sad ending where the bad guy wins and the cycle starts over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky stories about ghosts and dark secrets.
